alternateDiagonalScreen.scope: Indexed polygon bounds and triangle contact vertices, fan triangulation, 1e-9 length tolerance. Contacts are allowed only on common topological vertices/edges (4e-9 boundary tolerance). Floating-point screen; degeneracy and manifold checks are separate.

independentAdjacentInteriors.scope: Independent HiGHS feasibility/maximum-interior-margin problems for every shared-vertex face pair after triangle AABB pruning. Reports strict interior contacts above 1e-7 barycentric margin; boundary-only contacts and smaller margins are outside this supplemental test.

independentBVH.scope: Blender BVH candidates followed by double-precision triangle intersection tests (1e-9 tolerance), fan triangulation. Shared-vertex polygon pairs excluded. Not a complete test of adjacent folds, coplanar contacts or every self-intersection.
